paper_title: MIG Automatic Data Selection for Instruction Tuning by Maximizing   Information Gain in Semantic Space

model_annotation: The chart illustrates the quality scores of three categories, IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, across two metrics, represented by blue and pink bars. The horizontal axis lists the categories in the order IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, while the vertical axis is labeled "Scores" and ranges from 30 to 70 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. The blue bars, labeled "Avg eq" in the legend, have values of 63.98, 66.06, and 67.64 for IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, respectively, with the tallest bar corresponding to DEITA and the shortest to IFD. The pink bars, labeled "Avg sup" in the legend, have values of 41.90, 39.13, and 42.99 for IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, respectively, with the tallest bar corresponding to DEITA and the shortest to TagNum. Two horizontal dashed lines are present, a blue line labeled "Base Avg eq" at a value of 64.71 and an orange line labeled "Base Avg sin" at a value of 37.91. The bars are grouped by category, with the blue and pink bars appearing together for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting order beyond the categorical listing on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding indicated in the legend.
